fusions.name: Reef Rake
fusions.desc: A raking kick that deals 18 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more for each.

fusions.name: Breaker Charge
fusions.desc: Charges through a wide cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances and leaving everything in it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tide-Hardened
fusions.desc: Damage you take falls by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wave Runner

riders.text: and the reef in you grows back
and nothing that has to wade can catch you

fusions.desc: You can gallop across water. From bronze rank you move 15% faster on it, from silver your health recovers 20% faster there, and from gold your dodge chance on water rises by 10%.
